# Armory

> Where agents gear up: 60,000+ open-source agent components (MCP servers, skills, hooks, sub-agents, rules, CLIs, evals and more), ranked on public evidence. Search, rank and install them from a CLI (`armory`), an MCP server (`armory-mcp`), skills, a Claude Code plugin or the site. Its keeper is Armiger, and it restocks itself every night.

Two things live in this repository: Armory's own harness (everything named `armory-*`, plus `cli/` and `armory-mcp/`) and the catalog it aggregates (the 12 category folders, `brain/` and the generated `catalog.json`). Never hand-edit `catalog.json`.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what Armory is, every tool and how to call it, the hard rules
- [README.md](README.md): install from any coding agent, the five zones of the repository, the sources it mirrors
- [SOUL.md](SOUL.md): Armiger, the agent that keeps the registry: persona, boundaries
- [HARNESS.md](HARNESS.md): Armory's own harness against the catalog it aggregates
- [STRUCTURE.md](STRUCTURE.md): every root folder with a one-line purpose

## Skills

- [armory](armory-skill/SKILL.md): find and install the best component instead of hand-rolling one
- [armory-vet-component](skills/armory-vet-component/SKILL.md): check provenance, licence, ranking and install-time code before installing
- [armory-submit](skills/armory-submit/SKILL.md): add a component Armory does not list yet
- [armory-restock](skills/armory-restock/SKILL.md): refresh the registry the way the nightly loop does

## MCP tools

- [Armory MCP server](armory-mcp/src/index.ts): search_components, get_component, rank_components, search_catalog, submit_component (run with `npx -y armory-mcp`)
- [Claude Code plugin](.claude-plugin/plugin.json): the MCP server, the skills, two sub-agents and a session reminder in one install
- [Plugin guide for every harness](PLUGIN.md): Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI and Hermes

## Docs

- [CLI](cli/README.md): `armory search`, `rank`, `get`, `install`, `init`, `submit`, `sandbox-run`, `memory-search`, `runs`
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): how the brain, the catalog, the site, the CLI and the MCP server fit
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): the one-file component contract
- [Self-improvement contract](dsip.json): the nightly loop, its gate and how a change is rolled back
- [Nightly receipts](AUTOLAB-LOG.md): one line per restock with the catalog total
